title: Chapter 2953 - 177: Debt Collection and Murder_3
content:
Chapter 2953: Chapter 177: Debt Collection and Murder_3

But at this moment, everything was off.

As Elder You released his Divine Sense, his eyes suddenly widened, "Not good!"

He immediately attempted to stand up.

Almost at the moment he stood up, a cold undead hand clawed its way up from beneath him, clutching his neck.

The undead hand clawed tightly around Elder You’s neck, long fingernails piercing into his flesh.

There was even Corpse Poison, slowly seeping into Elder You’s blood.

"A Late Golden Core Stage undead?!"

Elder You’s complexion turned pale, and in the next moment, his skin and flesh began to deform, expand, and ultimately transform into a human-shaped "balloon."

The undead’s hand claw suddenly tore.

The balloon was ripped apart, the human skin burst into fragments, flying everywhere.

But Elder You’s figure appeared five zhang away.

He had escaped using some unknown strange method, making use of the self-explosion of human skin from the clutches of the hand claw.

The escaped Elder You, covered in blood, and his human skin surprisingly began to heal slowly.

Simultaneously, on his face, amidst the dripping blood and flesh, his original visage gradually returned.

A "Human Skin Shedding Talisman" was expended.

Anger and shock grew within his heart.

Who was it?!

Could have pinpointed his location and sent such a vicious "undead" to assassinate him?

Under the protection of the ancestor’s Sword Talisman and the Heavenly Mechanism Treasure, any observation towards him would either be severed beforehand by the Heavenly Sword or isolated by the Heavenly Spirit Tool Heart Protecting Mirror.

No one could figure out his Cause and Effect under the protection of the Hua family ancestor and the Heavenly Mechanism Supreme Treasure.

At least not here in the Great Wilderness, definitely not...

"Impossible..."

Elder You’s gaze was fierce.

And just at this moment, the ground rose, earth and rocks flew, revealing a tall corpse.

The corpse was cloaked in layers of black Heavy Armor, inscribed with an Earth Element Array, its aura merging with the earth, hard to detect.

And this undead’s right hand still held a piece of human skin, looking thoroughly disturbing.

From its eye sockets, a deep and eerie blue light revealed a cruel intent to kill.

In the instant of locking eyes with this undead, Elder You felt a chill run over his scalp, and at the same time, he instantly recognized it.

Divine Priest’s Undying Slave!

Sibone General!

It’s that Divine Priest!

Calculated his location and dispatched his undead general to sneak underground in the night, to kill him!

Elder You felt icy cold in his heart, having roamed the Cultivation World for so long, this was his first time encountering such a calculated situation against his footing, having his territory trespassed, and being blocked inside his house to be "killed"...

Meanwhile, on the distant mountain ridge.

Mo Hua, donned in Divine Priest robes, stood atop the mountain, with the Golden Core Holy Tiger by his side.

Lugu led a group of Barbarian Armor Heavy Soldiers, following behind Mo Hua.

In Mo Hua’s eyes, a peculiar blue light flashed by, before he gently waved his hand, "Kill!"

Lugu let out a low roar, "Kill!"

Then, he took the lead, drawing the Demon Bone Cutting Knife, leading the Barbarian Soldiers like Demon Soldiers in the night, rushing towards the core base of the Hua family in the Ghost Cry Mountain Realm.

And in Mo Hua’s eyes, at the moment the blue light flashed by, within the base, the undead’s "Sishen" eyes, the blue light of killing intent also suddenly surged.

Sinister Taotie Patterns emerged from within the Heavy Armor.

With a mighty roar, "Sishen" swept with a deadly evilness wind towards Elder You.

It adhered to the command of its master, similarly marked with Taotie Patterns, to obliterate all enemies.

It seemed as if the two Taotie Formations resonated.

Sishen’s movements became even more adept.

The circulation of Spiritual Power became even swifter.

Its aura received a certain degree of "enhancement," making the ferocity of the Taotie even stronger.

Elder You’s face couldn’t help but show a trace of fear.
